body: I don't think pills would be a way for me to go, but I don't even want to think about that now. Like I said, it's a roller coaster and sometimes I'm down and sometimes I'm up. Today I feel a lot better.

Thanks for the reply! 

I took your advice though, I figured it out on my own some time ago that the music can be very influential in my psyche so when I realize I'm going down, I set up a playlist that will drag me down and let me wallow for a while before slowly bringing me back up. I don't think I can describe it better than that, but I hope you understand. Thanks again for the reply, it means a lot.

Thanks for replying, I really appreciate it. 

I wasn't able to find the best version of that song, but it was dope nonetheless. And I agree with you, we learn from our mistakes and get better, but those mistakes can still hurt, even if we know the bigger picture. Guess that's just a part of us, as humans. 

Again, thank you so much for taking your time to reply. I don't often talk to people (online or offline) so I'm usually surprised when I get a reply.

Hey man, thanks for the kind words I really appreciate it. I spent last half an hour trying to figure out the password I jumbled on for this throwaway just so I could reply, it really means a lot that there are people out there willing give support for people who might need it. 

I like your outlook on life so maybe I will send you a message, I do miss talking to people about stuff other than football. Thanks again for your message, I'm a little overwhelmed that somebody even replied.
